name: Archi's Acres Guesthouse
description: Archi's Acres Guesthouse is an agritourism farm in 10079 W. Lilac Road, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
